description.summary: a capture source whose content the user switches

protocol.description: A call or a stream often has to show one window, then another, then a whole output, and stopping the share to pick again in the portal dialog interrupts it. A dynamic capture source captures whatever the compositor's cast target is at each frame: a window, an output or nothing. The user changes the target with the compositor's own controls; the session goes on.

interface.name: lys_dynamic_capture_source_manager_v1
interface.description: A privileged global: compositors hide it from sandboxed clients.

request.name: create_source

description.summary: create a source that follows the cast target

request.description: An ext_image_copy_capture_session_v1 on this source captures the cast target as it is at each frame. When the target changes, the session is not stopped: it sends new buffer constraints when the size changes, and the next frame's damage covers the whole buffer. Without a target, frames are a solid fill at the last target's size, damaged only when the target goes. A session created before the first target is chosen waits for it before its first constraints.
